desc: Implement the iterative DFS sliding-window solution in the starter code: build the adjacency list, traverse from root 0 with explicit enter/exit events, maintain root-distance-by-depth, last occurrence depth per value, and the current unique-value window left boundary, then update the global answer with longest length and minimum node count.
Validate the implementation against the provided examples and edge cases such as duplicate values on a chain, all unique values, star-shaped trees, and paths of length 0.

If validation fails, switch to an alternative approach (e.g., nearest same-value ancestor constraint propagation, Euler-tour range-max updates, persistent segment tree with binary lifting, or centroid decomposition as a fallback).
